file.column_matching: case-insensitive; spaces, hyphens, dots and underscores ignored (so 'EMI Due Date' = 'emi_due_date'); accepts aliases

row_validation.registered_mobile: normalise: strip spaces, '+91', leading '0'; result must be 10 digits starting 6-9
row_validation.due_date: valid date (YYYY-MM-DD or DD-MM-YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY)

quarantine_reasons.MISSING_FIELD: a mandatory field is empty (names the field)
quarantine_reasons.INVALID_MOBILE: mobile not 10 digits starting 6-9 after normalising
quarantine_reasons.INVALID_AMOUNT: EMI not > 0, or overdue negative / non-numeric
quarantine_reasons.DUPLICATE_LOAN_ID: loan_id appears more than once in the file - ALL copies quarantined (cannot tell which is right)

warnings_not_quarantine.DPD_DUE_DATE_MISMATCH: file DPD differs from (upload date - due date) by more than 1 day; file DPD is used
warnings_not_quarantine.CONSENT_NOT_PROVIDED: no consent column for a channel; channel treated as not consented until supplied
warnings_not_quarantine.OUT_OF_SCOPE_DPD: DPD < -6; row loads but K01 will not contact it

exclusions_decided: Only invalid data is rejected at upload (decided 19 Nov). Out-of-scope DPD, STOP/DNC and duplicate enrollment across campaigns are enforced at send time by K01 / the Supervisor reservation.

grouping.rule: one contact plan per customer_id: K01 caps, holds, STOP and stop-for-day apply across all of the customer's loans
grouping.per_loan: payments, receipts, DPD, overdue and obligation clearing stay per loan_id; clearing one loan leaves the others open
grouping.mobiles: every registered_mobile on any of the customer's loans is valid for K10 identity

reupload.existing_loan: update amounts, DPD, due date, status and optional fields; KEEP journey state, holds, history, PTPs, consents captured in conversation
reupload.missing_from_new_file: status REMOVED_BY_LENDER; no new sends; history kept
reupload.versioning: every upload gets upload_id + version number + row counts; every loan records the upload version that last changed it
reupload.idempotent: re-uploading the same file changes nothing and enqueues nothing

campaign.loan_dates_vs_campaign_dates: kept separate: due_date belongs to the loan; allocation dates belong to the campaign
campaign.arm: allowed only when >= 1 loan is budgeted (explicitly confirmed) and all mandatory campaign inputs are set
preview_before_arm: campaign pool = budget_per_case x budgeted loans (see budget_scope)
campaign.start: automatically at 08:00 on the first contact day on/after allocation_start_date (skips Sundays and national holidays per K01)
campaign.end: no new outbound sends after 19:00 on allocation_end_date (end date inclusive); inbound servicing continues
campaign.early_stop: K01 stop conditions (pool exhausted or collection target met)

budget_scope.case_definition: one loan account (loan_id), always linked to its customer_id; a customer with 2 loans = 2 cases
budget_scope.budgeted_loans: ONLY the loans explicitly selected for budgeting. A loan is eligible for selection if it was ACCEPTED at upload and is IN SCOPE (DPD >= -6).

selection_methods.explicit_list: ops user supplies the loan_ids to budget (file column budget_flag=Y, or a separate list)
selection_methods.filter: ops user defines a filter (e.g. DPD band, product, location) - resolved to a fixed loan list at arm time

budget_scope.default_if_not_specified: ARMING BLOCKED - the budgeted set must be specified; the preview proposes 'all eligible loans' and the user must confirm it
never_budgeted: loans not in the selected set
budget_scope.contact_rule: only budgeted loans are contacted for collection; a customer is contacted if at least one of their loans is budgeted
budget_scope.cost_attribution: a touch to a customer is charged across that customer's budgeted loans in equal shares
preview_must_show: pool = per-case budget x budgeted loans
budget_scope.reupload: budgeted set does not change silently. Explicit list: new loans are NOT added until the user selects them. Filter: new matching loans are proposed and need confirmation. REMOVED_BY_LENDER loans leave the set; pool recomputes on the current set; spend already incurred stays counted.
